messages.author: 28f7cf43544f2467
messages.subject: geom_line troubles
parts:
Ran into an issue today that I can't seem to figure out. In the course
of some (supposed) routine plotting of data...geom_line() decided to
stop behaving as I expected.

Here's the code:

example = read.table("http://dl.dropbox.com/u/3734701/
example.txt",header=T)
plot = ggplot(example,aes(SynDay,BATxConcentration))
plot + geom_point() + geom_line()

Why are the dots not connecting? Does the data used for geom_line()
have to be of a certain class? What am I missing?

plot + geom_line() produces an empty graph.

Any insight is appreciated.

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: geom_line troubles
parts:
Hi,

the SynDay in your code is not regarded as Date class. Try:

example$SynDay2<-as.Date(example$SynDay)
ggplot(example,aes(SynDay2,BATxConcentration)) + geom_point() + geom_line()

HTH.
